_comment: ChangeGuard Plan V3 Work Package E2.1: Confidence Filter Grid Configuration

mask_provenance.sar_valid_mask_description: Binary sensory raster recording physical SAR observation validity (1=valid, 0=nodata). Strictly independent of ground-truth labels.
mask_provenance.label_description: Ground truth annotation raster (3=unannotated/invalid, 2=flood, 0,1=other land cover).
mask_provenance.adaptation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1). Strictly NO ground-truth labels and NO label-3 exclusion during adaptation.
mask_provenance.offline_evaluation_mask_definition: valid = (MK0_MNA == 1) & (MK0_MLU != 3). Strictly evaluated offline on frozen predictions.

confidence_grid_cells.name: Weak-Strong Consistency (No Confidence Filter)
confidence_grid_cells.description: All sensory-valid pixels included in one-way KL consistency loss; no confidence filtering.

confidence_grid_cells.name: Weak-Strong Consistency (Confidence >= 0.70)
confidence_grid_cells.description: Confidence threshold tau=0.70 on max weak probability over sensory-valid pixels.

confidence_grid_cells.name: Weak-Strong Consistency (Confidence >= 0.90, Primary Reference)
confidence_grid_cells.description: Predefined primary reference: confidence threshold tau=0.90 on max weak probability.

confidence_grid_cells.name: Weak-Strong Consistency (Confidence >= 0.95)
confidence_grid_cells.description: Confidence threshold tau=0.95 on max weak probability over sensory-valid pixels.
